# NEW 2026-11-24 v26.0 WP11 Full Roman Empire Theme System Expansion (4 Praetorian Prefectures + 79 Regions + E01-E10).
# Generated by gen_v260_theme_empire.py from data/oe_theme_regions_empire.json; edit the SSOT/generator, not this file.

# Any scope. Synchronizes global_var:oe_phoenix_empire across BYZ -> ROM tag swaps and refreshes IO leaders.
oe_phoenix_empire_sync = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            country_exists = c:ROM
            c:ROM = {
                is_rebel_country = no
                OR = {
                    has_or_had_tag = BYZ
                    AND = {
                        exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
                        is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_phoenix_empire value = c:ROM }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_phoenix_empire value = c:BYZ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_phoenix_empire value = c:ROM }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_phoenix_empire } remove_global_variable = oe_phoenix_empire }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_phoenix_empire exists = global_var:oe_phoenix_empire }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
                if = {
                    limit = { OR = { international_organization_has_leader = no NOT = { leader_country ?= global_var:oe_phoenix_empire } } }
                    set_leader_country = global_var:oe_phoenix_empire
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_policy_org }
            international_organization:oe_byz_policy_org = {
                if = {
                    limit = { OR = { international_organization_has_leader = no NOT = { leader_country ?= global_var:oe_phoenix_empire } } }
                    set_leader_country = global_var:oe_phoenix_empire
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). Monthly O(themes) update of capped overlord modifier counters + active Prefecture count.
oe_theme_empire_sync_caps = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_army value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_civil value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_navy value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_frontier value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_charter value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_latin value = 0 }
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
        if = { limit = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme } prev = { change_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_army add = 1 } } }
        else_if = { limit = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_administrative } prev = { change_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_civil add = 1 } } }
        else_if = { limit = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_naval } prev = { change_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_navy add = 1 } } }
        else_if = { limit = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_frontier } prev = { change_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_frontier add = 1 } change_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_army add = 1 } } }
        else_if = { limit = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_italian } prev = { change_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_charter add = 1 } } }
        else_if = { limit = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_latin } prev = { change_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_latin add = 1 } change_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_army add = 1 } } }
    }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_army min = 0 max = 15 }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_civil min = 0 max = 10 }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_navy min = 0 max = 10 }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_frontier min = 0 max = 8 }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_charter min = 0 max = 8 }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_latin min = 0 max = 6 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_prf_active value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_prf_mode_1 ?= 1 var:oe_prf_mode_1 ?= 2 } } change_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_prf_active add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_prf_mode_2 ?= 1 var:oe_prf_mode_2 ?= 2 } } change_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_prf_active add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_prf_mode_3 ?= 1 var:oe_prf_mode_3 ?= 2 } } change_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_prf_active add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_prf_mode_4 ?= 1 var:oe_prf_mode_4 ?= 2 } } change_variable = { name = oe_te_cap_prf_active add = 1 } }
}

    location:cologne = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied } remove_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied } }
    location:mainz = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied } remove_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied } }
    location:augsburg = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied } remove_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied } }
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
        if = { limit = { exists = capital capital = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_center } } capital = { set_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_id } oe_theme_mark_region_center_by_id = { var = oe_theme_region_id } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region } oe_theme_mark_region_center_by_id = { var = oe_t2_absorbed_region } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_2 } oe_theme_mark_region_center_by_id = { var = oe_t2_absorbed_region_2 } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_3 } oe_theme_mark_region_center_by_id = { var = oe_t2_absorbed_region_3 } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_4 } oe_theme_mark_region_center_by_id = { var = oe_t2_absorbed_region_4 } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_5 } oe_theme_mark_region_center_by_id = { var = oe_t2_absorbed_region_5 } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_6 } oe_theme_mark_region_center_by_id = { var = oe_t2_absorbed_region_6 } }
    }
}

# Location scope (scope:oe_theme_seat). Spawns founding army garrison & coastal cogs for non-naval, non-Italian themes.
# Zero country triggers evaluated on $owner$ (dry-run tooltip safe).
oe_theme_found_spawn_army_garrison = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_t2_seat_region_size >= 13 }
        while = { count = 3 create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = oe_byz_theme_subject_soldier_I owner = $owner$ } }
        if = { limit = { is_coastal = yes } while = { count = 6 create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_cog owner = $owner$ } } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_t2_seat_region_size >= 7 }
        while = { count = 2 create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = oe_byz_theme_subject_soldier_I owner = $owner$ } }
        if = { limit = { is_coastal = yes } while = { count = 4 create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_cog owner = $owner$ } } }
    }
    else = {
        create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = oe_byz_theme_subject_soldier_I owner = $owner$ }
        if = { limit = { is_coastal = yes } while = { count = 2 create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_cog owner = $owner$ } } }
    }
}

# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). Finalizes Pillars membership + exact special_status, naming/metadata, and hub post deployment
# WITHOUT evaluating any country triggers (is_subject_type, oe_pillars_classify_member_effect, etc.) on scope:target_building_country.
oe_theme_found_finalize_package = {
    scope:target_building_country = {
        if = { limit = { exists = ruler } ruler = { add_trait = trait:oe_character_war_score_trait_VI } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
            add_country_to_international_organization = scope:target_building_country
            international_organization_add_special_status = {
                type = special_status:$special_status$
                country = scope:target_building_country
            }
        }
    }
    # Historical/classical naming & O(1) region/prefecture/diocese metadata
    scope:oe_theme_seat = {
        save_scope_as = oe_theme_name_seat
        set_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied
    }
    scope:target_building_country = {
        oe_theme_apply_name = yes
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_seat = { has_variable = oe_theme_region } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_region_id value = scope:oe_theme_seat.var:oe_theme_region } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_seat = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_tier } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_distance value = scope:oe_theme_seat.var:oe_theme_region_tier } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_seat = { has_variable = oe_theme_prefecture } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_prefecture value = scope:oe_theme_seat.var:oe_theme_prefecture } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_theme_seat = { has_variable = oe_theme_diocese } } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_diocese value = scope:oe_theme_seat.var:oe_theme_diocese } }
    }
    # WP11-2 Option 2A: deploy posts ONLY on province capitals & towns/cities/megalopolises in this region
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = {
            var:oe_theme_region ?= scope:oe_theme_seat.var:oe_theme_region
            oe_theme_is_hub_location = yes
            NOT = { this = scope:oe_theme_seat }
        }
        construct_building = { building_type = building_type:$post$ owner = scope:target_building_country cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
    }
}

# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). Unified WP11 Option 2A hub-deploying theme founding at scope:oe_theme_seat.
# Handles BYZ/ROM overlord dynamically, auto-applies Naval for R58/R59 and Italian/Latin route for R54-R57.
# Zero country triggers evaluated on scope:target_building_country (safe under option tooltip dry-runs).
oe_theme_found_at_seat_empire = {
    save_scope_as = oe_emp_overlord
    # Determine subject package by region default course + Italian two-way choice
    if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_theme_seat = { OR = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 58 var:oe_theme_region ?= 59 } is_coastal = yes } }
        scope:oe_theme_seat = {
            create_building_country_in_location = {
                religion = religion:orthodox
                culture = culture:oe_roman_noble_culture
                subject_type = subject_type:oe_empire_theme_naval
                overlord = scope:oe_emp_overlord
                reforms = { oe_byz_theme_naval_subject }
                hidden_effect = { change_government_type = government_type:monarchy change_heir_selection = heir_selection:oe_rome_province_elect }
                save_scope_as = target_building_country
            }
            construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_naval_seat owner = scope:target_building_country cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
        }
        oe_theme_found_finalize_package = { special_status = oe_pillars_naval_theme post = oe_byz_theme_naval_post }
        scope:oe_theme_seat = {
            oe_theme_create_ten_current_age_galleys = { owner = scope:target_building_country }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_theme_italian_unlocked
            scope:oe_theme_seat = { OR = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 54 var:oe_theme_region ?= 55 var:oe_theme_region ?= 56 var:oe_theme_region ?= 57 } }
        }
        scope:oe_theme_seat = {
            create_building_country_in_location = {
                religion = religion:orthodox
                culture = culture:oe_roman_noble_culture
                subject_type = subject_type:oe_empire_theme_italian
                overlord = scope:oe_emp_overlord
                reforms = { oe_byz_theme_italian_subject }
                hidden_effect = { change_government_type = government_type:monarchy change_heir_selection = heir_selection:oe_rome_province_elect }
                save_scope_as = target_building_country
            }
            construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_italian_seat owner = scope:target_building_country cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
        }
        oe_theme_found_finalize_package = { special_status = oe_pillars_italian_theme post = oe_byz_theme_italian_post }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_theme_latin_unlocked
            scope:oe_theme_seat = { OR = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 54 var:oe_theme_region ?= 55 var:oe_theme_region ?= 56 var:oe_theme_region ?= 57 } }
        }
        scope:oe_theme_seat = {
            create_building_country_in_location = {
                religion = religion:orthodox
                culture = culture:oe_roman_noble_culture
                subject_type = subject_type:oe_empire_theme_latin
                overlord = scope:oe_emp_overlord
                reforms = { oe_byz_theme_latin_subject }
                hidden_effect = { change_government_type = government_type:monarchy change_heir_selection = heir_selection:oe_rome_province_elect }
                save_scope_as = target_building_country
            }
            construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_latin_seat owner = scope:target_building_country cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
        }
        oe_theme_found_finalize_package = { special_status = oe_pillars_latin_theme post = oe_byz_theme_latin_post }
        scope:oe_theme_seat = {
            oe_theme_found_spawn_army_garrison = { owner = scope:target_building_country }
        }
    }
    else = {
        scope:oe_theme_seat = {
            create_building_country_in_location = {
                religion = religion:orthodox
                culture = culture:oe_roman_noble_culture
                subject_type = subject_type:oe_empire_theme
                overlord = scope:oe_emp_overlord
                reforms = { oe_byz_theme_system_subject }
                hidden_effect = { change_government_type = government_type:monarchy change_heir_selection = heir_selection:oe_rome_province_elect }
                save_scope_as = target_building_country
            }
            construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system_noble owner = scope:target_building_country cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
        }
        oe_theme_found_finalize_package = { special_status = oe_pillars_theme post = oe_byz_theme_system }
        scope:oe_theme_seat = {
            oe_theme_found_spawn_army_garrison = { owner = scope:target_building_country }
        }
    }
    scope:target_building_country = {
        set_gold = 300
        add_manpower = 3
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_named } oe_theme_admin_init = yes }
    }
}

# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). Batch-founds all creatable themes in Prefecture $pref$ (1..4), deducting $cost$ Authority each.
oe_theme_found_prefecture = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_found_pref_count value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_found_pref_last value = $pref$ }
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = {
            oe_theme_region_center_creatable = yes
            var:oe_theme_prefecture ?= $pref$
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                oe_theme_region_center_creatable = yes
                exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
                international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { var:oe_pillars_authority >= $cost$ }
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_theme_seat
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -$cost$ } }
            owner = {
                oe_theme_found_at_seat_empire = yes
                change_variable = { name = oe_theme_found_pref_count add = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    oe_theme_empire_sync_caps = yes
}

# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). Absorbs scope:oe_ex_donor into scope:oe_ex_anchor cleanly during E01-E10 consolidation.
oe_theme_exarchate_merge_one = {
    save_scope_as = oe_ex_overlord
    scope:oe_ex_donor = {
        if = { limit = { exists = capital } capital = { save_scope_as = oe_ex_old_seat } }
        ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ex_former_strat }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_ex_gold value = oe_t2_half_gold }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_ex_mp value = oe_t2_half_manpower }
        every_owned_foreign_building_location = {
            limit = { oe_owned_by_phoenix_empire = yes oe_theme_is_hub_location = yes }
            oe_t2_construct_matching_post = { owner = scope:oe_ex_anchor }
        }
        every_army = { change_unit_owner = scope:oe_ex_anchor }
        every_navy = { change_unit_owner = scope:oe_ex_anchor }
    }
    scope:oe_ex_anchor = {
        add_gold = scope:oe_ex_gold
        add_manpower = scope:oe_ex_mp
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_ex_donor = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_id } }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region } } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_region value = scope:oe_ex_donor.var:oe_theme_region_id } if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ex_old_seat } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_seat value = scope:oe_ex_old_seat } scope:oe_ex_old_seat = { set_variable = oe_t2_merged_center set_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied } } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_count value = 1 } }
            else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_region_2 value = scope:oe_ex_donor.var:oe_theme_region_id } if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ex_old_seat } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_seat_2 value = scope:oe_ex_old_seat } scope:oe_ex_old_seat = { set_variable = oe_t2_merged_center set_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied } } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_count value = 2 } }
            else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_region_3 value = scope:oe_ex_donor.var:oe_theme_region_id } if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ex_old_seat } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_seat_3 value = scope:oe_ex_old_seat } scope:oe_ex_old_seat = { set_variable = oe_t2_merged_center set_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied } } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_count value = 3 } }
            else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_region_4 value = scope:oe_ex_donor.var:oe_theme_region_id } if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ex_old_seat } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_seat_4 value = scope:oe_ex_old_seat } scope:oe_ex_old_seat = { set_variable = oe_t2_merged_center set_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied } } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_count value = 4 } }
            else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_5 } } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_region_5 value = scope:oe_ex_donor.var:oe_theme_region_id } if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ex_old_seat } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_seat_5 value = scope:oe_ex_old_seat } scope:oe_ex_old_seat = { set_variable = oe_t2_merged_center set_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied } } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_count value = 5 } }
            else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region_6 } } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_region_6 value = scope:oe_ex_donor.var:oe_theme_region_id } if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ex_old_seat } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_seat_6 value = scope:oe_ex_old_seat } scope:oe_ex_old_seat = { set_variable = oe_t2_merged_center set_variable = oe_theme_region_occupied } } set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_count value = 6 } }
        }
        set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty
    }
    scope:oe_ex_former_strat ?= {
        if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } move_country = scope:oe_ex_overlord reset_ruler_title = {} }
    }
    annex_country = { country = scope:oe_ex_donor reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes }
}

# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). Consolidates E01 色雷斯大军区 (Grand Theme of Thrace).
oe_theme_consolidate_e1 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_theme_exarchate_e1_ready = yes }
        # Prefer the anchor-region theme (e.g., BYT01 for E02), else the largest member theme in the group
        if = {
            limit = { any_subject = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now } var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 2 } }
            random_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now } var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 2 } save_scope_as = oe_ex_anchor }
        }
        else = {
            ordered_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now } OR = { var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 2 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 3 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 4 } } order_by = oe_theme_jurisdiction_size max = 1 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_ex_anchor }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_ex_anchor }
            every_subject = {
                limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now } NOT = { this = scope:oe_ex_anchor } OR = { var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 2 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 3 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 4 } }
                save_scope_as = oe_ex_donor
                prev = { oe_theme_exarchate_merge_one = yes }
            }
            scope:oe_ex_anchor = {
                set_variable = { name = oe_theme_exarchate_id value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_theme_prefecture value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_theme_diocese value = 1 }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { tag = BYT01 } }
                    change_country_name = OE_THEME_EXARCHATE_E1
                    change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_EXARCHATE_E1_ADJ
                    set_variable = oe_theme_name_fixed
                }
            }
            change_variable = { name = oe_theme_exarchate_merged_count add = 1 }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). Consolidates E04 爱琴—克里特海军大军区 (Grand Naval Theme of Aigaion).
oe_theme_consolidate_e4 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_theme_exarchate_e4_ready = yes }
        # Prefer the anchor-region theme (e.g., BYT01 for E02), else the largest member theme in the group
        if = {
            limit = { any_subject = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now } var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 19 } }
            random_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now } var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 19 } save_scope_as = oe_ex_anchor }
        }
        else = {
            ordered_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now } OR = { var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 19 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 20 } } order_by = oe_theme_jurisdiction_size max = 1 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_ex_anchor }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_ex_anchor }
            every_subject = {
                limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now } NOT = { this = scope:oe_ex_anchor } OR = { var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 19 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 20 } }
                save_scope_as = oe_ex_donor
                prev = { oe_theme_exarchate_merge_one = yes }
            }
            scope:oe_ex_anchor = {
                set_variable = { name = oe_theme_exarchate_id value = 4 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_theme_prefecture value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_theme_diocese value = 2 }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { tag = BYT01 } }
                    change_country_name = OE_THEME_EXARCHATE_E4
                    change_country_adjective = OE_THEME_EXARCHATE_E4_ADJ
                    set_variable = oe_theme_name_fixed
                }
            }
            change_variable = { name = oe_theme_exarchate_merged_count add = 1 }
        }
    }
}

            limit = { any_subject = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now } var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 5 } }
            random_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now } var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 5 } save_scope_as = oe_ex_anchor }
        }
